# implicit-sdf.library: UnionDistance

**Status:** Supported (tier `geometry`). In a shipping tier; the lint, type-check, and code-generation gates cover it. No release promises its signature yet.

## Summary

> The union of two sampled distances: the minimum. Exact.

## Signature

```plato
UnionDistance(a: Number, b: Number): Number
```

## Laws

These are declared laws. Whether each one passes is recorded by the law runner ([stdlib/VERIFICATION.md](../../../../../stdlib/VERIFICATION.md)), not by this page.

### Law_UnionIsCommutative

[stdlib/tests/implicit-sdf.laws.plato, line 149](../../../../../stdlib/tests/implicit-sdf.laws.plato#L149)

```plato
// Union and intersection are commutative.
Law_UnionIsCommutative(a: Number, b: Number): Boolean
    => UnionDistance(a, b).LawEq(UnionDistance(b, a));
```

### Law_UnionIsIdempotent

[stdlib/tests/implicit-sdf.laws.plato, line 156](../../../../../stdlib/tests/implicit-sdf.laws.plato#L156)

```plato
// Union with self changes nothing (idempotence), and likewise intersection.
Law_UnionIsIdempotent(a: Number): Boolean
    => UnionDistance(a, a).LawEq(a);
```

### Law_UnionIsNoGreaterThanOperands

[stdlib/tests/implicit-sdf.laws.plato, line 164](../../../../../stdlib/tests/implicit-sdf.laws.plato#L164)

```plato
// The union of two shapes is contained in each, so its distance is no greater
// than either operand's — the absorption direction that makes Union a minimum.
Law_UnionIsNoGreaterThanOperands(a: Number, b: Number): Boolean
    => UnionDistance(a, b) <= a && UnionDistance(a, b) <= b;
```

### Law_SmoothUnionIsNoGreaterThanUnion

[stdlib/tests/implicit-sdf.laws.plato, line 181](../../../../../stdlib/tests/implicit-sdf.laws.plato#L181)

```plato
// Smoothing a union only ever rounds material ON: the blended distance is never
// greater than the sharp minimum. Precondition mirrors the body's — a positive
// blend radius.
Law_SmoothUnionIsNoGreaterThanUnion(a: Number, b: Number, blendRadius: Number): Boolean
    => blendRadius <= 0.0
    || SmoothUnionDistance(a, b, blendRadius) <= UnionDistance(a, b) + 1e-4;
```

### Law_ChamferUnionIsNoGreaterThanUnion

[stdlib/tests/implicit-sdf.laws.plato, line 203](../../../../../stdlib/tests/implicit-sdf.laws.plato#L203)

```plato
// A chamfer only ever removes material from the sharp corner, never adds: the
// bevel plane term can lower the minimum but the leading Min keeps it from
// rising. Guarded to the body's precondition.
Law_ChamferUnionIsNoGreaterThanUnion(a: Number, b: Number, width: Number): Boolean
    => width <= 0.0
    || ChamferUnionDistance(a, b, width) <= UnionDistance(a, b) + 1e-4;
```

### Law_CircularUnionAwayFromSeamIsUnion

[stdlib/tests/implicit-sdf.laws.plato, line 226](../../../../../stdlib/tests/implicit-sdf.laws.plato#L226)

```plato
// Far from the seam — where both operands exceed the fillet radius — the exact
// circular union has nothing to round and must agree with the sharp minimum.
Law_CircularUnionAwayFromSeamIsUnion(a: Number, b: Number, radius: Number): Boolean
    => radius <= 0.0 || a < radius || b < radius
    || CircularUnionDistance(a, b, radius).LawEq(UnionDistance(a, b));
```

### Law_ExponentialSmoothUnionIsNoGreaterThanUnion

[stdlib/tests/implicit-sdf.laws.plato, line 241](../../../../../stdlib/tests/implicit-sdf.laws.plato#L241)

```plato
// Exponential smoothing, like the polynomial form, never exceeds the sharp
// minimum it approximates.
Law_ExponentialSmoothUnionIsNoGreaterThanUnion(a: Number, b: Number, blendRadius: Number): Boolean
    => blendRadius <= 0.0
    || ExponentialSmoothUnionDistance(a, b, blendRadius) <= UnionDistance(a, b) + 1e-4;
```

**Source:** [stdlib/geometry/implicit-sdf.library.plato, line 604](../../../../../stdlib/geometry/implicit-sdf.library.plato#L604).

```plato

    //==
    // # Distance operators
    //
    // Pointwise CSG on already-sampled distances: the scalar kernels the field
    // combinators in `fields-implicits.library.plato` are written in terms
    // of, usable directly inside a hand-written distance function without
    // allocating a field.
    //
    // Each fidelity claim below (`implicit-sdf.concepts.plato`) is stated for
    // exact operands; feed it a lower bound and the result is a lower bound, feed
    // it something that is not a bound and neither is the result.

    // The union of two sampled distances: the minimum. Exact.
    UnionDistance(a: Number, b: Number): Number
        => a.Min(b);
```
